claim: The assigned evidence archive was verified against the dashboard SHA-256 before extraction.
exact_locator: whole file, 11977 bytes
proves: The archive analysed is byte-identical to the one issued for set D5.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the contents were interpreted correctly, only that they are unaltered.
alternative_considered: The archive could have been re-downloaded after modification.
disposition: Retained: the hash matches the dashboard value recorded before extraction.

claim: The OpenSCAP profile was enumerated rather than guessed, and CIS Level 1 Server selected.
exact_locator: Profiles block, id xccdf_org.ssgproject.content_profile_cis_server_l1
proves: The available profile list was read from the installed data stream before selection.
does_not_prove: Does not prove Level 1 is the correct choice for every environment, only that the selection was informed.
alternative_considered: Running --profile cis would have selected Level 2 Server, visible in the same output.
disposition: Retained: the enumerated list shows the bare cis identifier maps to Level 2.

claim: The pre-hardening scan recorded 101 failed and 159 passed rules with zero errors.
exact_locator: rule-result elements, result values fail and pass
proves: The security posture of the host before any remediation was applied.
does_not_prove: Does not prove compliance or certification; it is configuration state at one point in time.
alternative_considered: A different profile would produce different counts.
disposition: Retained: the profile and data stream are pinned and identical in the after-scan.

claim: Lynis independently recorded a hardening index of 66 before remediation.
exact_locator: hardening_index=66
proves: A second, independent tool corroborates the OpenSCAP baseline.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the two tools measure the same controls.
alternative_considered: Tool agreement could be coincidental.
disposition: Retained as corroboration only; OpenSCAP remains the primary measure.

claim: The web content carried mode 0666 at baseline, a planted world-writable defect.
exact_locator: row for /srv/netforge-service/index.html
proves: The defect HR-003 remediates was present before the role ran.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the file was exploited or that mode was the only weakness.
alternative_considered: The mode could have been altered between capture and remediation.
disposition: Retained: the capture is timestamped and precedes the first apply.

claim: Rollback restores the effective SSH configuration byte-identically to baseline.
exact_locator: whole file, compared by diff against live sshd -T after rollback
proves: The rollback play returns declared configuration to its recorded baseline state.
does_not_prove: Does not prove every host attribute is restored, only the declared comparison set.
alternative_considered: A partial restore could coincidentally satisfy a narrow check.
disposition: Retained: the comparison is a full-file diff, not a substring match.

claim: sysctl output cannot be hash-compared because it contains values that change on every read.
exact_locator: two SHA-256 values and the diff of differing keys
proves: Two captures of an unmodified host produce different hashes, naming kernel.random.uuid among the causes.
does_not_prove: Does not prove every sysctl key is volatile; six specific keys are named.
alternative_considered: The host might have changed between captures.
disposition: Retained: the captures were seconds apart with no intervening change, and the diff names only volatile keys.

claim: Listener output cannot be hash-compared because it embeds process identifiers.
exact_locator: two SHA-256 values and the stable projection
proves: ss -tulpn embeds PID and fd values that change on process restart and reboot.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the listening ports themselves are unstable; the projection shows they are not.
alternative_considered: A service could have restarted between captures.
disposition: Retained: the stable projection is identical across both captures.

claim: The rollback comparison set is declared, with volatile artefacts excluded and reasons recorded.
exact_locator: hash_stable and excluded_from_hash_comparison arrays
proves: Which baseline facts rollback verifies against, and which are excluded.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the excluded artefacts are irrelevant, only that they are not hash-comparable.
alternative_considered: Excluding artefacts could hide a failed restore.
disposition: Retained: each exclusion carries an alternative comparison method.

claim: package_nginx_removed is a false positive on this host and was deliberately not remediated.
exact_locator: rule rationale quotation and service-contract.yml extract
proves: The rule is conditional on the web server not being needed; the service contract requires it.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the rule is wrong in general, only that its premise fails here.
alternative_considered: The service contract could be satisfied by another web server.
disposition: Retained: the contract names the running nginx service and forbids disabling it.

claim: The baseline login banner was recovered from the host, not from the current package.
exact_locator: comparison of 9.3 host content against rocky-release 9.8 package content
proves: The two sources disagree, and the host state was used.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the check-mode diff captured the file perfectly, though it was read by Ansible from the live file.
alternative_considered: The newer package could be considered authoritative.
disposition: Weakened: the package differs from what this 9.3 host actually carried.

claim: The post-hardening scan recorded 86 failed and 174 passed rules with zero errors.
exact_locator: rule-result elements, result values fail and pass
proves: The security posture after the eleven remediations were applied.
does_not_prove: Does not prove compliance or certification.
alternative_considered: A different scan configuration would invalidate the comparison.
disposition: Retained: identical data stream, profile and command as the baseline scan.

claim: Fifteen rules moved from fail to pass with zero regressions.
exact_locator: FIXED and REGRESSIONS sections
proves: The measurable effect of the hardening role, rule by rule.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the remaining 86 failures are acceptable; two carry documented dispositions and 84 are out of scope.
alternative_considered: Rules could have moved for reasons unrelated to the role.
disposition: Retained: every fixed rule maps to a designed remediation in lab/remediations.yml.

claim: Lynis independently moved from 66 to 70 after remediation.
exact_locator: hardening_index=70
proves: A second tool corroborates the measured improvement.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the size of the improvement is significant.
alternative_considered: The index could move for unrelated reasons.
disposition: Retained as corroboration only.

claim: The unattended lifecycle passed all eight stages, with the second apply reporting changed=0.
exact_locator: STAGE 3/8 recap and LIFECYCLE RESULT line
proves: The role is idempotent and the full baseline-harden-rollback-reapply cycle completes unattended.
does_not_prove: Does not prove idempotence under every possible starting state.
alternative_considered: changed=0 could be produced by suppressing change reporting.
disposition: Weakened: no task uses changed_when false except a read-only sshd validator.

claim: The host acceptance suite passes 57 tests with zero failures.
exact_locator: testsuite element, tests and failures attributes
proves: All four declared service checks and every remediation are verified against live host state.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the services behave correctly under load or over time.
alternative_considered: Tests could pass by re-running the tool that made the change.
disposition: Weakened: the suite reads host state through testinfra and never invokes Ansible.

claim: Exactly three treatments were selected under the USD 85,000 budget.
exact_locator: selection object, selected_treatment_ids and total_cost
proves: The portfolio produced by the documented optimiser from the submitted inputs.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the underlying loss estimates are accurate.
alternative_considered: A greedy selection by return per dollar could differ.
disposition: Retained: enumeration is exact and cannot be defeated by dependency constraints.

claim: The selection is unchanged at both edges of the 30 percent uncertainty band.
exact_locator: selection_by_case and selection_stable_across_band
proves: The funding decision does not depend on the precision of the loss estimates.
does_not_prove: Does not address uneven error across findings, only uniform error.
alternative_considered: Stability could be an artefact of a narrow band.
disposition: Retained: the band is the 30 percent required by the private overlay.

claim: Every risk parameter is derived from the supplied export by a stated rule.
exact_locator: rationale field on each risk object
proves: Frequency, loss, control effectiveness and dependency values each trace to evidence in the export.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the tiering thresholds are correct, only that they are applied consistently.
alternative_considered: Parameters could have been chosen to produce a desired outcome.
disposition: Weakened: the tiers are applied mechanically to export fields, and the sensitivity test shows the ranking is robust.

claim: Nine risks are deferred with named owners, acceptance authorities and review triggers.
exact_locator: decision, owner, acceptance_authority and review_trigger columns
proves: Deferral is a recorded decision rather than an omission.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the owners have accepted the risks.
alternative_considered: Deferral could be a way of avoiding difficult remediations.
disposition: Retained: the deferred set includes both CVSS 9.8 findings and excludes none on cost grounds alone.

claim: Every remediation was designed with a precheck verified against the live host before implementation.
exact_locator: verify_precheck fields and the design_corrections section
proves: Four design entries were corrected after verification, before any task was written.
does_not_prove: Does not prove the corrected designs are complete.
alternative_considered: The design could have been written after the fact.
disposition: Weakened: the design_corrections section records what was wrong and why.
